name: Aurea Palace Lima
description: A quiet seafront retreat above the Pacific cliffs, with spacious rooms, a rooftop pool and a restaurant focused on local seafood.

name: Aurea Sacred Valley Lodge
description: A restored hacienda among Andean terraces, offering garden suites, guided hikes and a spa fed by mountain springs.

name: Aurea Harbour House
description: A boutique hotel in a converted harbour warehouse, with exposed brick, a library bar and views over the fishing quay.

name: Aurea Lake Retreat
description: A lakeside retreat in the Patagonian forest, with timber cabins, a heated deck and a kitchen built around regional produce.

name: Aurea Amalfi Terrace
description: Whitewashed terraces step down a cliff above the Tyrrhenian Sea, between lemon groves and quiet stone stairways.

name: Aurea Kyoto Garden House
description: A timber townhouse arranged around a moss garden, with tatami rooms and a tea room open to the morning light.

name: Aurea Marrakech Riad
description: A hidden courtyard riad with a central fountain, carved cedar ceilings and a rooftop for evening tea.

name: Aurea Santorini Caldera
description: Cave-style suites carved into the caldera rim, with plunge pools facing the sunset over the volcanic bay.

name: Aurea Alpine Chalet
description: A timber chalet at the foot of the peaks, with a wood-fired sauna and rooms that open onto snow-covered pastures.

name: Aurea Lisbon Palace
description: A restored palace on a hillside street, with tiled halls, a walled garden and views over the red roofs and the river.

name: Aurea Bali Rice Villa
description: Open-air villas between terraced rice fields, with long verandas, a jungle-edge pool and a slow morning rhythm.

name: Aurea Cape Winelands
description: A Cape Dutch manor surrounded by vineyards and mountains, with a cellar library and a long veranda for late lunches.

name: Aurea Dolomites Refuge
description: A mountain refuge of pale wood and stone, facing jagged peaks that turn pink at dusk, with a quiet reading lounge.

name: Aurea Reykjavik Lava Lodge
description: A low lodge of dark timber set in a lava field, with geothermal baths and wide windows for the northern lights.

name: Aurea Oaxaca Courtyard
description: A colonial courtyard house with arched corridors, a bougainvillea patio and a kitchen devoted to regional cooking.

name: Aurea Tulum Cenote Retreat
description: Palm-roofed bungalows beside a freshwater cenote, a short walk through the jungle from a quiet white beach.

name: Aurea Sydney Harbour Loft
description: A harbour-front loft hotel in a converted wool store, with exposed beams, tall windows and a rooftop over the water.

name: Aurea Queenstown Lakeside
description: Glass-fronted lodges on the edge of a mountain lake, with fireplaces, a lakeside deck and a view of the ridgeline.

name: Aurea Dubai Dune Retreat
description: A desert camp of sand-coloured villas among the dunes, with private courtyards, stargazing and a slow sunset ritual.

name: Aurea Istanbul Bosphorus
description: An old waterside mansion on the Bosphorus, with carved wooden ceilings, a hammam and a terrace facing the ferries.

name: Aurea Lofoten Fjord Cabins
description: Red timber cabins on the water's edge between steep peaks, with a shared sauna and long summer evenings of light.

name: Aurea Provence Lavender Estate
description: A stone farmhouse among lavender fields, with shuttered rooms, a shaded courtyard and a pool facing the hills.

name: Aurea Tuscan Villa
description: A hilltop villa among cypress and olive trees, with frescoed rooms and a long table set for dinner outdoors.

name: Aurea Seoul Hanok
description: A courtyard hanok in a quiet old neighbourhood, with heated floors, paper doors and a view of the palace roofs.

name: Aurea Hoi An Riverside
description: A riverside house of yellow walls and wooden shutters, with lantern-lit courtyards and a garden facing the water.

name: Aurea Chiang Mai Teak House
description: A teak house among orchards at the foot of the mountains, with raised verandas, a lotus pond and a quiet spa.

name: Aurea Arenal Cloud Forest
description: Canopy-level lodges in the cloud forest below a volcano, with hanging bridges, a hot spring and birdsong at dawn.

name: Aurea Vienna Secession
description: A turn-of-the-century townhouse near the old centre, with a grand staircase, a salon for chamber music and a quiet courtyard.

name: Aurea Edinburgh Old Town
description: Stone-vaulted rooms in a historic close, with a library, a peat fire and views toward the castle ridge.

name: Aurea Banff Mountain Lodge
description: A lodge of logs and glass in the Rockies, with a stone fireplace, a hot pool and trails starting at the door.
